about_the_game:
Upgrade It is a unique idle game with near-endless possibilities. Maximize your income by upgrading generators, purchasing powerful boosts, and unlocking new gameplay features. Leverage a unique prestige system to permanently empower your generators after a local progress reset. Collect achievements and complete all in-game goals to claim victory!

You start with 99 income generators. Optimize your profits by upgrading each one individually. Use up to 10 special prestige upgrades per generator by performing a localized reset. Invest in special currency generators and find the optimal strategy to complete every goal and challenge!

Features:

  • Addictive Idle Gameplay: Easy to start, hard to put down.

  • Deep Prestige System: A complex and rewarding loop of progression and reset.

  • 1,000+ Unique Upgrades: A vast array of power-ups to discover and purchase.

  • Full Automation: Auto-buyers and extra currencies passive generators streamline your progress.

  • In-Game Challenges: Optional objectives for added motivation and replayability.

  • Steam Achievements: Prove your mastery and dedication.

  • Polished Presentation: A clean user interface with customizable graphics and satisfying sound effects.

  • Complete Experience: This is a full release, not an Early Access game - dive into a polished and fun experience right now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - i7 Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 750Ti / AMD Radeon R9 270x
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
